includes: four numerical intakes and full scores

claims.scope: New candidate phases/resolutions only; same score family and machine, previously used comparator grids, no external/statistical independence.

decision.inconclusive: Missing/unclassified work, incomplete action domain/intake, source/environment/resource/clock or host interruption.
decision.negative: All four scores complete/eligible but score or refinement hurdle fails; refinement failure leaves true-score gain numerically unresolved, not evidence of worsening.
decision.positive: All four full-domain scores eligible, both per-target refinement checks pass and candidate <=0.99*control on both grids.

host.cleanup: After scientific termination, signal owned assertion, poll terminal, verify absence; retain every attempt.
host.conditions: AC plus both owned assertions at admission, sampled during and after scientific termination; failed query or observed loss invalidates enclosing result.

producer_prerequisites: AC and owned sleep assertions admitted within30s
reuse: Explicitly reuse frozen equilibria; no new solve/fit and no matched-compute claim.
